edt_preparation_microbenchmark.name: BenchmarkKernelPacingReadyBatch
edt_preparation_microbenchmark.conditions: Same benchmark helper and persistent send-worker state; three runs per batch size; median; host GOAMD64=v3.
limitations: Only EDT preparation; excludes syscalls, encryption and complete service workload.
Whole production xray.service includes background traffic and the SSH sampling path.
Server restart reconnects QUIC; no NAT or fixed source-port workaround was used.
BBR and transport fixes also changed; CPU difference cannot be assigned solely to batching.
100 MB individual source requests returned HTTP 403; valid 25 MB requests were used instead.
All three post-restart rows are retained, including the slower first round.

clinical_mihomo.metric: Concurrent 1 KiB HTTP request time_starttransfer; includes request/network/server overhead and is not ICMP RTT.
clinical_mihomo.finding: Connection probes OnAppLimited; concrete sent handler previously exposed only NotifyAppLimited. Real bridge added, explicit idle retained during tail flight, sparse readiness gated from STARTUP bandwidth plateau.
limitations: FQ drop counters are interface aggregate, not per-connection.
Short WAN runs with changing network conditions; no long-term fairness or ISP capacity claim.
